skill.summary: Extract calendar events and action points from forwarded emails, store them for review, and create calendar events with duplicate detection. Use when the user forwards an email containing meeting invites, events, deadlines, or action items, and wants to extract structured items for calendar creation. Also use when the user asks to review previously extracted items or create calendar events from them.
